name: TCELongBench
description: TCELongBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate Large Language Models' proficiency in handling temporal dynamics and understanding extensive text within Temporal Complex Events composed of many news articles over extended periods. It includes tasks such as reading comprehension, temporal sequencing, and future event forecasting.
reputation: A relatively new benchmark with limited adoption so far, mainly appearing in recent LLM evaluations on long-context temporal reasoning.
notes: Focuses on temporal reasoning over long contexts using news articles; uses retrieval-augmented generation and long context LLMs.
